description: An object defined by its values, not its identity: equal fields mean equal objects. Best kept immutable and hashable.
Instead of copying on every read, build a new object when the data changes and let readers keep sharing the old one safely.
A unique `object()` marking 'not provided' so that `None`, `0` and `""` remain valid data. Compare it with `is`.
The plan's decisions agree with each other and with the numbers in the briefing (hashable implies immutable, read volume rules out copying on read).
Architecture Decision Record: context, decision, alternatives considered and consequences.
